gloss: New Year's party; New Year's gathering

definitions.gloss: New Year's party; New Year's gathering
definitions.explanation: A social gathering or party held in early January to celebrate the new year, typically organized by workplaces, clubs, or groups of friends. Counterpart to the year-end party ({忘年会|ぼうねんかい}).

examples.japanese: {新年会|しんねんかい}の{幹事|かんじ}を{任|まか}された。
examples.english: I was put in charge of organizing the New Year's party.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{新年会|しんねんかい}は{一月|いちがつ}の{第二週|だいにしゅう}に{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The company New Year's party is held in the second week of January.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}のサークルの{新年会|しんねんかい}で{久|ひさ}しぶりにみんなに{会|あ}えた。
examples.english: I got to see everyone again for the first time in a while at the university club's New Year's party.

notes:
An important social custom in Japan, especially in the workplace. The {新年会|しんねんかい} is the counterpart to the {忘年会|ぼうねんかい} (year-end party). While the {忘年会|ぼうねんかい} aims to forget the troubles of the outgoing year, the {新年会|しんねんかい} marks a fresh start and sets a positive tone for the year ahead.

FORMATION:
{新年|しんねん} (new year) + {会|かい} (gathering, party)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新年会|しんねんかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a New Year's party
- {新年会|しんねんかい}の{会場|かいじょう}: the New Year's party venue
- {新年会|しんねんかい}の{幹事|かんじ}: the New Year's party organizer
- {職場|しょくば}の{新年会|しんねんかい}: a workplace New Year's party

RELATED TERMS:
- {忘年会|ぼうねんかい}: year-end party — held in December
- {歓迎会|かんげいかい}: welcome party — for new members or employees
- {送別会|そうべつかい}: farewell party — for departing members
